description: This is a SCSS source file defining a mixin library for responsive font sizes, paddings, margins, and other CSS properties based on screen size and resolution. It includes configuration variables, helper functions, and media query mixins for responsive design with support for two-dimensional resizing.

methods.name: divide
methods.description: Performs division with specified precision, considering units such as px, rem, em, and %.

methods.name: rfs-value
methods.description: Calculates a responsive CSS value based on input list, converting units as needed.

methods.name: rfs-fluid-value
methods.description: Calculates a fluid, responsive CSS value with media query considerations.

methods.name: rfs
methods.description: Main mixin that applies responsive font size or other property based on input values and screen size.

methods.name: font-size
methods.description: Shorthand for applying responsive font size.
